policy: Only individually measured pulsar and neutron-star companion masses from relativistic timing or optical spectroscopy, keyed by exact ATNF PSRJ name. Total-mass-only systems and model-dependent X-ray mass fits are not split into component masses.

J0418+5732.note: ATNF lists no distance. The commonly assumed 2 kpc is not a measurement.

J0420-5022.note: ATNF lists no distance. An absorption estimate, not a parallax.

J0613-0200.note: Replaces ATNF's 0.78 kpc (Desvignes et al. 2016) with the inverse of the 1.00(5) mas NANOGrav 15-year parallax as listed by ATNF; inside the 0.95-1.27 kpc range of Reardon et al. 2016.

J0806-4123.note: ATNF lists no distance. 240 +/- 25 pc from sodium absorption, not a parallax.

J1012+5307.note: Replaces ATNF's 0.70 kpc (Verbiest et al. 2012); MSPSRpi Table 6 gives 0.877(35) kpc.

J1024-0719.note: Replaces ATNF's 1.22 kpc (Bassa et al. 2016); MSPSRpi Table 6 gives 1.08(6) kpc.

J1643-1224.note: Replaces ATNF's 0.74 kpc (Reardon et al. 2016); MSPSRpi Table 6 gives 0.95 +0.15/-0.11 kpc.

J1730-2304.note: Replaces ATNF's 0.62 kpc (Reardon et al. 2016); MSPSRpi Table 6 gives 0.51(3) kpc.

J1809-1943.note: First magnetar parallax, 0.40(5) mas, 2.5 +0.4/-0.3 kpc; replaces ATNF's 3.6 kpc (Verbiest et al. 2012).

J1856-3754.note: ATNF's 0.16 kpc (Verbiest et al. 2012) rests on the 6.2 mas parallax of van Kerkwijk & Kaplan 2007; Walter et al. 2010 redetermined it at 8.16 mas, 123 +11/-15 pc, adopted by Mignani et al. 2013.

J1939+2134.note: Replaces ATNF's 3.5 kpc (Desvignes et al. 2016); MSPSRpi Table 6 gives 2.9 +0.3/-0.2 kpc.

J2322-2650.note: Parallax 1.3(2) mas, 0.80 +0.18/-0.12 kpc, close to the 0.76 kpc model distance. Replaces ATNF's 2.0 kpc and supersedes the 4.4(12) mas, 230 pc of Spiewak et al. 2018, whose uncertainty is 6 times larger.

J1856-3754.scope: Ho et al. 2007 assumed this mass in the atmosphere model that fits its spectrum. A lone neutron star has no companion to weigh it against.

J0348+0432.note: Supersedes the 2.01(4) M_sun of Antoniadis et al. 2013, which rested on a white-dwarf model.

J0737-3039A.note: The published interval is +0.000012/-0.000014 M_sun; the larger side is stored.

J0737-3039B.note: The published interval is +0.000013/-0.000011 M_sun; the larger side is stored.

J1614-2230.note: The published interval is +0.012/-0.013 M_sun; the larger side is stored. The mass is set by radio timing.

J1829+2456.note: The uncertainty is the published 95% confidence interval.

neutronStarCompanions.note: The uncertainty is the published 95% confidence interval.
